reason: ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month, every month, is a bill I don't need when my register and WhatsApp already work. I don't pay monthly for anything I can do myself for free.
objection: Another monthly charge that never stops, and on top of that my girls will feel I am spying on them with this selfie check-in. I'll lose staff goodwill to save a few minutes of counting.
would_change_my_mind: A one-time price with no monthly fee, or no setup charge and much cheaper monthly, and the selfie check-in made optional so my staff don't feel watched.
